simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַצָּבָה (H4675) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַצָּבָה (matstsâbâh) means a military guard First listed occurrence: 1Sam 14 12.

definitions.full: H4675. mitstsabah מַצָּבָה noun feminine מ ׳אַנְשֵׁי 1Sam 14:12 see מַצָּב . מִצָּבָה noun feminine guard, watch ? — only מ ׳לְבֵיתִי וְחָנִיתִי Zech 9:8 and I encamp as watch for my house (so We Now GASm, but dubious; Kue Sta Marti Kau GASm read מַצָּבָה , but this probably non-existent, see above; ᵑ0 apparently intends because of a host = מִצָּבא ).
